common.physical_identity: All three writes target the same original live Gauge/sample subobject; root and both child incarnations survive; guard remains the same sibling. Copy payloads and equal addresses are not issuer/currentness authority.
common.currentness: Each actual replace must account for Change(sample) and ancestor current facts without changing root/child lifetime identity. The second LT write is value-equal (41 to 41); equality alone cannot waive currentness/issuer obligations. No numeric ID freshness convention is assumed without the public interface contract.
common.scope: Each loan capability ends before caller continuation; phase+1 is performed only for phase 0,1,2 and yields 1,2,3. No callee RETURN targets main or its loop.

N01_wrong_return_type.question: u8 function attempts RETURN of usize

N02_callee_break.question: callee has no lexical loop; caller loop is not its target

N03_callee_continue.question: callee has no lexical loop; caller loop cannot supply one

N04_caller_fallthrough.question: callee RETURN leaves caller alive; true caller-loop path illegally falls through

N05_continue_wrong_type.question: u8 Continue argument mismatches usize loop parameter

N06_mixed_if_binding_boundary.question: mixed-return IF bound to chosen with later normal continuation; outside Issue admission family

P01_tail_if_control.question: normal IF result in both arms; no explicit callee return

P02_then_return.question: explicit RETURN in LT true arm; normal false arm

P03_else_return.question: normal LT true arm; explicit RETURN in false arm

P04_both_return.question: both LT arms explicitly RETURN; no normal IF result

P05_final_return_normal_if.question: normal IF result bound to chosen, then explicitly returned

P06_eq_copy_both_return.question: one Copy phase binding, EQ condition, both arms RETURN

layer_rules.positive: Canonical legal source. Expected selected family candidate applicability; unsupported/precision safe refusal is recorded separately, not invalid-source rejection or native PASS. An unexplained semantic diagnostic, invalid proof, wrong exit/state, unsafe C or native/sanitizer discrepancy triggers STOP.
layer_rules.invalid_negative: Reject no later than semantic source CHECK and never issue valid owned proof or emitted C. Early syntax/unsupported refusal is safe but does not validate the targeted semantic check. Unexpected acceptance triggers STOP, with no guest execution.
layer_rules.legal_boundary: Canonical legal. Ordinary CHECK acceptance is permitted. The Issue excludes later mixed-IF-result binding continuation from the declared admission family: expect safe owned/emitter refusal if unsupported. Unexpected proof/emission beyond that family is preserved and returned to C before native; do not call this language-invalid merely because unsupported.
layer_rules.observability: The vectors are source-semantic predictions, not a claim that every public/native layer exposes them. Record actual internal/proof observations separately from caller-result and guest observations; missing public whole-loop validation remains missing.
